description: Skills manifest for Hermes-Agents-Forge: domain search terms, generation policy, and security rules. No pre-authored skills; all capabilities are generated per role.

generative.policy: When builtins do not cover a role's core workflow, generate a bespoke skill using skill_manage create. Follow the house format: When to Use / Procedure / Pitfalls / Verification. Keep description under 60 characters. Ground the skill in the user's interview answers. Never duplicate an enabled builtin.

security_gate.policy: All skill installs (generative or Hub) are scanned by Hermes's built-in scanner. On a dangerous verdict, skip and report — never --force past a verdict.
rules: Scan every generated skill before install.
Scan every Hub skill before install.

closing_rules: Start with builtins: hermes -p <name> skills list — a covering builtin satisfies the need.
If no builtin covers the role, generate a bespoke skill (generative tier).
Only search the Hub for genuine remaining gaps.
Record the inventory per profile: builtins covering the role, generated skills, hub skills, genuine gaps.
